# Cloud agent workflow

- Implement the requested change in the Astro and Tailwind app. Follow the repository conventions in `AGENTS.md`.
- Add or update tests for changed behavior, then run `npm run verify` from the repository root. Keep existing coverage and checks in place.
- If verification fails, diagnose the first failure, make a focused fix, and rerun verification. Record any remaining failures and exact commands in the draft PR.
- Include a short summary and verification results in the PR. Leave it as a draft for the owner to review and merge.
